nodes.text: Amid concerns over the #HMPV outbreak in #China, Atul Goel, Director General of Health Services, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, reassured the public in a video message shared by the Health Ministry that there is no cause for alarm.

nodes.author: TareenAneesa
nodes.text:
The officials stated that they remain vigilant and are closely monitoring the situation. They emphasised that there is no reason for the public to worry, as proactive measures are in place to address any potential concerns.
